nl: I prefer to work independently, without someone watching me all the time.
en: Ik werk het liefst zelfstandig, zonder dat iemand steeds meekijkt.

ro: I prefer to work independently, without someone watching me all the time.
ar: I prefer to work independently, without someone watching me all the time.

ro: I want clear instructions and fixed frameworks before I start.
ar: I want clear instructions and fixed frameworks before I start.
